extras: Desktop-only, works entirely from local vault files, performs no authentication, telemetry, or network requests. Not supported by Obsidian Publish or external Markdown renderers.
intentEvidence: Edit AlgoForge algorithms visually and embed them in your notes.
problem: Users need a way to visually edit and embed complex algorithm definitions directly within their Obsidian notes without leaving the application.
summary: AlgoForge allows users to visually edit AlgoForge algorithm files and embed the resulting code previews directly within Obsidian notes.
